author: WREG
title: Retired judge nominated as interim City Court Clerk - NewsBreak
text:
3 hours ago
MEMPHIS, Tenn. -- Two Memphis Municipal Court Judges are set to appoint an interim City Court Clerk following the dismissal of Clerk Sukita Johnson in April.
Johnson was sworn in as City Court Clerk of the Memphis Municipal Courts on January 2, 2024, and was terminated on April 7, 2026, by Judges Varonica Cooper and Kenya Hooks.
According to Memphis Municipal Administrative Judge Jayne Chandler, the action came after irregularities in the office were discovered following citizen complaints.
Tami Sawyer makes appearance for court hearing On April 14, 2026, Attorney Johnson appeared before the Memphis City Council to formally request an appeal regarding her termination.
An administrative hearing between the Judges and Johnson is scheduled for August 28, 2026.
Judges Cooper and Hooks have recommended that retired Judge Earnestine Hunt Dorse serve as interim City Court Clerk.
